comments.text: Summaraze  in few sentences about me: As a contemporary artist collected worldwide I believe in the innovative approach to art investment, which leverages the power of tokenization to make art more accessible to a wider audience.

Alongside my professional career, I pursued painting at a professional level and progressed from an amateur to a bestselling artist in 2020 and was featured in Art & Finance media. I am specialized in large-scale portraits, abstract and figurative paintings. Currently based in Italy and working in my own studio/exhibition space in Bergamo, Italy and collaborate with international designers and architects. My artwork has been exhibited in various cities across Italy, Austria, and Switzerland, and is collected by clients from the UAE, US, Canada, Ukraine, numerous European countries, Scandinavia, Russia and Japan. I have a supportive community of collectors and fans I am sharing my art and knowledge with on Instagram, Facebook and  LinkedIn.
My work in tech and entrepreneurship enabled me to travel extensively and develop skills in sales, business development, digital marketing, product design, and branding.

I believe my knowledge in the art business, web3 experience and positive attitude might contribute well to Aptos community and become a trustful resource for those not yet introduced to blockchain technology.
